scope: The 13 active legacy Admin content screens imported by the legacy content router: community, CMS articles, and mini-program live operations. Status measures screen semantics, not route-name similarity.

statusDefinitions.candidate: The routed screen's primary operations have a new Admin screen and executable authenticated API contracts; production E2E is still required.
statusDefinitions.partial: A replacement screen exists, but one or more active legacy operations or relationships are absent or materially simplified.
statusDefinitions.missing: No new Admin screen currently implements the active legacy operation.

routes.title: 社区话题
routes.covered: Search, paginated catalog, create, edit, visibility, recommendation, reference-protected delete, and relationship-count maintenance are executable from the consolidated screen.
routes.remaining: Production historical-data validation and real-role browser E2E remain required before cutover acceptance.

routes.title: 社区内容
routes.covered: Moderation counters, filters, detail, edit entry, visibility, recommendation, star level, approve, reject, forced take-down, and delete are available with transactional aggregate correction.
routes.remaining: Production historical-data validation, real-role E2E, and operational acceptance of consolidated navigation remain required.

routes.title: 添加内容
routes.covered: Platform content create and edit cover title, body, image or video, gallery, topic and product relations, recommendation, visibility, star, sorting, bounded inputs, and database serialization.
routes.remaining: Production media URL validation, historical-data validation, and real-role create/edit E2E remain required.

routes.title: 社区评论
routes.covered: Comment search, moderation, visibility, reply tree inspection, platform reply, fictitious comment creation, and cascading delete are exposed with aggregate correction.
routes.remaining: Production tree-shape validation and real-role browser E2E remain required before cutover acceptance.

routes.title: 社区设置
routes.covered: All six legacy community, content moderation, video moderation, comment visibility, comment publishing, and comment moderation flags have a dedicated screen, strict input contract, serialized upsert, database readback, audit log, and CONFIG_KV invalidation.
routes.remaining: Duplicate production rows must be cleared through DB-003 before writes, and a real-role production read/write/readback E2E is still required.

routes.title: 文章管理
routes.covered: The consolidated replacement provides title, category and status filters, bounded pagination, cover and synopsis display, product relation, visibility and campaign markers, create, edit, and verified recoverable delete.
routes.remaining: Production historical-data validation and real-role list, filter, edit, relation, and delete E2E remain required before cutover acceptance.

routes.title: 文章分类
routes.covered: The consolidated category tab implements the legacy flat catalog, title and status filters, image, introduction, sorting, create, edit, visibility, transaction readback, and article-reference-protected recoverable delete.
routes.remaining: Production historical-data validation and real-role category create, edit, status, and reference-protection E2E remain required before cutover acceptance.

routes.title: 文章添加
routes.covered: The editor covers title, author, required category and cover, existing-asset selection across nested material folders, synopsis, bounded HTML with formatting helpers and server sanitization, share fields, source URL, sorting, product relation, publish, hot and banner flags, and transactional dual-table readback.
routes.remaining: Production private-asset validation and real-role create/edit E2E remain required; uploads continue through the separately permissioned material center.

routes.title: 直播间管理
routes.covered: The replacement provides paginated local room inventory, status grouping, masked operator data, freshness indicators, and Queue-dispatched read-only status synchronization.
routes.remaining: Create, edit, delete, local visibility mutation, replay operations, goods assignment, and other remote WeChat writes are intentionally not migrated.

routes.title: 直播间管理
routes.covered: The new catalog can display and synchronize rooms after they exist, but it deliberately exposes no remote room-write form.
routes.remaining: Provider contract validation, idempotency, durable remote-write orchestration, create/edit UI, reconciliation, rollback policy, and production acceptance are required.

routes.title: 直播间商品管理
routes.covered: The replacement provides paginated local goods inventory, audit-state grouping, price display, freshness indicators, and Queue-dispatched read-only status synchronization.
routes.remaining: Create, edit, delete, resubmit, local visibility mutation, room assignment, and other remote WeChat goods writes are intentionally not migrated.

routes.title: 直播间商品管理
routes.covered: The new catalog can display and synchronize goods after they exist, but it deliberately exposes no remote goods-write form.
routes.remaining: Provider contract validation, idempotency, durable remote-write orchestration, create/edit UI, reconciliation, rollback policy, and production acceptance are required.

routes.title: 主播管理
routes.covered: The replacement provides a paginated, searchable local anchor catalog with masked contact details and freshness information.
routes.remaining: Create, edit, delete, role synchronization, local visibility mutation, and remote WeChat anchor operations remain intentionally absent.
